format.dimension_policy: Per-preview dimensions override the default to preserve source composition.

editorial_policy: Official generated footage only. Moving-reveal previews use authentic matched baseline/result pairs, a single thin divider and brief transparent in-frame method labels. Both videos advance at their original source speed during and after the wipe, with no fabricated degradation, frame holds, optical flow or extra looping. Other preview modes retain their own documented original-speed editing. No title strips, cards, progress indicators or color grading; posters are pure result footage.

previews.title: Reward Lightning: Fast Video Generation via Homologous Preference Distillation
previews.source_section: Official Comparison with Baseline / Wan2.2-I2V, row1: Wan2.2-4NFEs and Ours-4NFEs
previews.composition: Single official paired storm-sea example: a thin left-to-right boundary reveals detailed rolling waves, breaking surf and warm shafts of light. Both official outputs use 4 NFE and the same source example; no added blur or contrast adjustment. Their common source clock runs from 0 to 5 seconds and the revealed sea continues moving after 2.65 seconds.
previews.poster_selection: Clean result frame at 1.5 seconds: bright god rays above the rocks and a coherent foreground wave crest.
previews.selection_audit: All 80 consecutive used result frames reviewed at original 16fps, plus baseline/result paired contacts. No fast cuts or unrelated scenes. Full post-wipe 2.35-second action remains original footage. Encoded at 24fps by frame sampling, not interpolation.

previews.title: Phased One-Step Adversarial Equilibrium for Video Diffusion Models
previews.source_section: Official Comparison with Wan-I2V (Baseline), Group II regal woman / oil-painting example 3
previews.composition: Single real matched image-to-video comparison: the official 2NFE Wan-I2V result becomes blurred, while the official V-PAE 1NFE result retains a clear woman who gently turns her head and smiles. The blur is present in the published baseline video, never manufactured. One thin horizontal-traveling divider, then 2.35 seconds of uninterrupted original result motion.

comparison_evidence.naming_note: The section introduction says Wan-I2V-1NFE/guidance=1, but the actual Group II column label and filename explicitly identify base2 / WanI2V-2NFE/guidance=6. Caption follows the explicit column label and records this source inconsistency rather than equating NFE with sampling steps. Phased OAE is the homepage paper name for the official V-PAE model.
